title: Liver & Kidney Transplant in India
headline: Advanced Organ Transplant Care with High Success Rates & Affordable Costs
introduction: India is a global hub for organ transplantation, offering state-of-the-art transplant centers, experienced surgeons, and costs up to 70–80% lower than in the USA, UK, or UAE. With highly specialized medical teams and strict ethical practices, India is one of the most trusted destinations for liver and kidney transplants.
why_choose_india: Globally trained transplant surgeons with 20–30+ years of expertise
High success rates – Liver Transplant: 85–90%, Kidney Transplant: 90–95%
Advanced ICUs & labs for safe procedures
Affordable packages – save up to 80% compared to Western countries
Ethical & legal framework for donor-recipient safety

success_rates.Liver Transplant: 85–90% success rate (long-term survival with good lifestyle)
